articles.title: Wild Red Sox regular season ends with loss to Cubs at Rays’ Tropicana Field
articles.description: A long, strange 2026 Red Sox regular season came to a fittingly unusual end Sunday afternoon, with a loss to the Chicago Cubs at… the Tampa Bay Rays’ ballpark.

articles.title: Red Sox nemesis tabbed to start Game 1 of Wild Card series for Yankees
articles.description: In the first game of what they hope will be a deeper playoff run than last year, the Red Sox will face the pitcher who ended their 2025 postseason.

articles.title: Red Sox slugger back in lineup, key reliever goes to IL ahead of final game
articles.description: Willson Contreras is back in the lineup for Sunday’s regular season finale, but the Red Sox got some other tough injury news on the eve of the playoffs.

articles.title: MLB notes: Looking back on wild, unprecedented Red Sox season
articles.description: This weekend the Red Sox wrap up a season unlike any other in franchise history. Here’s a look back on the twists and turns that brought the club back to the playoffs.

articles.title: Pedro Martinez defends Blue Jays star after contract remark controversy
articles.description: This week Red Sox legend Pedro Martinez came to the defense of Blue Jays star Vladimir Guerrero Jr., who recently made some eyebrow-raising comments about his $500 million contract.

articles.title: Red Sox second half hero out with ‘significant’ biceps injury
articles.description: The Red Sox suffered a tough blow Friday when one of the club’s second half heroes suffered what is believed to be a significant biceps injury.

articles.title: Wilyer Abreu’s two-run double helps Red Sox complete doubleheader sweep
articles.description: Wilyer Abreu hit a two-run double in the bottom of the eighth to help the Red Sox complete a doubleheader sweep over the Chicago Cubs.

articles.title: Red Sox eager to ‘take care of business’ in Wild Card rematch with Yankees
articles.description: Members of the Red Sox are eager to ‘take care of business’ after Wild Card rematch with Yankees made official

articles.title: Red Sox regular-season finale moved to Tampa Bay ahead of storm
articles.description: With a nor’easter set to bring heavy rain to the region throughout the weekend, MLB has relocated the regular season finale between the Red Sox and Cubs to Tropicana Field.

articles.title: Red Sox first-base concerns grow with Mickey Gasper injury news
articles.description: Red Sox first-base depth takes another hit as Mickey Gasper leaves game in ‘pretty good discomfort’

articles.title: Red Sox option Raymond Burgos, recall rookie for 2nd game of doubleheader
articles.description: The Red Sox are bringing in a fresh arm for the second game of Friday’s doubleheader.

articles.title: Red Sox take Game 1 of Cubs doubleheader, cement Wild Card seeding
articles.description: Roman Anthony’s 3 for 3 performance carried the Red Sox to a comeback win in Game 1 of Friday’s Cubs doubleheader, and cemented Boston’s Wild Card seeding

articles.title: Red Sox playoff schedule: Dates for Wild Card series vs. Yankees
articles.description: With a win on Friday, the Red Sox locked in the second American League Wild Card and a trip to Yankee Stadium

articles.title: Red Sox, Cubs bracing for ‘strange’ series full of schedule changes
articles.description: Red Sox, Cubs brace for ‘strange’ series full of schedule changes as nor’easter barrels toward Boston

articles.title: Frustrated by lingering pain, Red Sox slugger casts doubt on availability
articles.description: A week after being hit in the right hand by a pitch, Red Sox slugger Willson Contreras still can’t swing a bat pain free, throwing his availability for the postseason into question.

articles.title: Lifeless Red Sox held to two hits in shutout loss to Guardians
articles.description: The Red Sox bats were silenced again in Thursday’s shutout loss to the Guardians, which cracked the door open to the possibility Boston could slip to the third Wild Card.
